subject: general
question:
Read the given statements and select the correct option.

Statement I: Only Sarvepalli Radhakrishnan and C Rajagopalachari were the first recipients of the Bharat Ratna.

Statements II: Sachin Tendulkar was awarded the Bharat Ratna in 2014, and he remains the first and only cricketer to have received this honor till 2024

options.text: Statement I is incorrect, while statement II is correct.
Both statement I and statement II are correct.
Statement I is correct, while statement II is incorrect.
Both statement I and statement II are incorrect.

solution:
The correct answer is __**Option 1**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] __Key Points__

__
 
• **Statement I is incorrect:** Because the first Bharat Ratna awardees were **three persons** in 1954 — C. Rajagopalachari, S. Radhakrishnan, and C.V. Raman.
 
• **Statement II is correct:** Sachin Tendulkar was awarded the Bharat Ratna in 2014, and he is the first and only cricketer to receive this honor as of 2024.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Bharat Ratna:**

 
 
• It is the highest civilian award in India.
 
• Established in 1954, it is awarded for exceptional service towards the advancement of Art, Literature and Science, and in recognition of Public Service of the highest order.
 
• The award does not carry any monetary grant but a certificate (Sanad) signed by the President and a medallion.
 
 
 
• **Sarvepalli Radhakrishnan:**
 
 
• He was an Indian philosopher and statesman who served as the first Vice President of India and the second President of India.
 
• He was awarded the Bharat Ratna in 1954 for his contribution to education and philosophy.
 
 
 
• **C. Rajagopalachari:**
 
 
• He was an Indian politician, independence activist, lawyer, writer, and statesman.
 
• He was the last Governor-General of India and a founder of the Swatantra Party.
 
• He was awarded the Bharat Ratna in 1954 for his public service.
 
 
 
• **Sachin Tendulkar:**
 
 
• He is a former Indian cricketer and one of the greatest batsmen in the history of cricket.
 
• He was awarded the Bharat Ratna in 2014, making him the youngest recipient and the first sportsperson to receive the award.
